description: We are a team of enthusiastic students passionate about space, technology, and innovation. We love exploring new ideas, solving challenges, and learning together. We welcome creative minds with skills in programming, AI/ML, research, and design to join us on this exciting journey!
summary: We developed a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive space-learning project that helps users understand space exploration through fun activities. It includes Saturn and Moon missions where players control an astronaut, collect important resources like food, water, oxygen, and power, and avoid obstacles. It also includes a space knowledge quiz to test users' learning. This project makes learning about space more interesting and engaging. It helps users understand the challenges astronauts may face during space missions while improving their knowledge through interactive gameplay.
details: Our project is an interactive Space Exploration Game where users explore Saturn and the Moon, collect oxygen, water, food and power, and earn points. It creates awareness about space exploration in an engaging way. We used Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js. Creativity, simplicity, learning and user experience guided our development.
